verdict.rationale: A probe got HTTP 200 for a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json, confirmed by its "openapi" key. The docs also describe a Registrar API for searching, checking, registering and managing domains, so a downloadable spec exists for the API surface that serves Registrar. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the spec includes the Registrar endpoints, first-party documentation of where to download the spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of its completeness.
